topography.project_purpose: WOWswap is a decentralized exchange (DEX) protocol that enables leveraged trading and liquidity provision across multiple chains. It uses a system of proxy contracts and tokens to facilitate swaps, farming, and staking, with a focus on capital efficiency and cross-chain interoperability.
topography.relationship_narrative: The WOWswap family relies on a shared set of proxy contracts (TransparentUpgradeableProxy, AdminUpgradeabilityProxy, UChildERC20Proxy) to manage upgradeability and cross-chain token representations. Core liquidity pairs and tokens are deployed across multiple chains, with proxies pointing to various implementations that handle trading logic and token bridging.
